IC1: - Symptomatic choledocholithiasis (choledocholithiasis demonstrated radiologically [OR] or highly suspected by clinical data (acute cholangitis [OR] or obstructive jaundice), analytical [OR] and imaging according to the criteria of high probability of choledocholithiasis established in the clinical guidelines (ASGE Guide).
IC2: - Discarded for surgical treatment due to age, comorbidity or refusal of the patient.
